reasoning: A complete 1660 English translation of the Physionomia (= Liber physiognomiae) is confirmed by Stasevich 2019 (Oxford Academic, The Library 20/4:533); 18th/19th c. English adaptations derived from it exist — all pre-1900. For the bound Secreta Aristotelis (= Secretum Secretorum), Robert Copland translated the complete work in 1528; nine medieval Middle English versions also exist — all pre-1900. Lin Kerns (2008) translates only Yonge's partial variant. No post-1900 complete modern English of the Liber physiognomiae found. Verdict: first_modern.
